title: Immigration Act 13 of 2002
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Immigration Act 13 of 2002'. Commencement: 20 February, 26 February and 12 March 2003 (all sections except s 37). Amended by Immigration Amendment Act 8 of 2016 among others.
notes: Covers visas, including the work visas in ss 19 and 21, permanent residence and employer duties (s 49).
